MATHS WORKSHEETS

Maths worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Counting, numbers and number writing — printable maths practice built from our own artwork. Every sheet twins with a real game in Counting & Number Recognition (Class 24) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.

Counting Caterpillar Age 4Class 24Maths Count every circle of the caterpillar, trace the number you find, and count rows of apples along the way. View Worksheet → Counting Apples Age 4Class 24Maths Count the apples in every row, draw exactly the right number into each basket, and trace your numbers. View Worksheet → Apple Counting Game Age 4Class 24Maths Count the apples row by row, write how many, then draw the whole basketful. View Worksheet → Balloon Number Writing Age 4Class 24Maths Ten balloons, ten numbers: write 1 to 10, one balloon at a time. View Worksheet → Busy Bee Honey Factory Age 4Class 24Maths Count the honey drops, then fill the three jars for the busy bees. View Worksheet → Butterfly Pattern Magic Age 4Class 24Maths One wing is dressed, the other is waiting: color the right wing to match the left. View Worksheet → Caterpillar Number Writing Age 4Class 24Maths The caterpillar circles are empty — fill them with 1 to 9, in order. View Worksheet → Cloud Castle Number Adventure Age 4Class 24Maths Fly the path: write 1 to 10 on the cloud stones, from the bird to the castle. View Worksheet → Counting Balloons Age 4Class 24Maths A party of balloons: count each row, then count them all. View Worksheet → Cupcake Bakery Age 4Class 24Maths Count the cupcakes, then share them onto the baker two plates. View Worksheet → Dinosaur Egg Rescue Age 4Class 24Maths Number the five eggs in the nest, then draw five more for the rescue. View Worksheet → Farm Animal Lineup Age 4Class 24Maths Five friends are queueing for the barn: number them first to fifth. View Worksheet → Garden Number Path Age 4Class 24Maths Ten stepping stones wind through the garden — number them 1 to 10. View Worksheet → Giraffe Height Challenge Age 4Class 24Maths Four giraffes, four heights: number them 1 to 4 from shortest to tallest. View Worksheet → Ice Cream Number Shop Age 4Class 24Maths Count the scoops, then build the cones: 1 scoop, 2 scoops, 3 scoops. View Worksheet → Little Builder Challenge Age 4Class 24Maths Count the blocks, then build: towers of 3, 4 and 5 on the platforms. View Worksheet → Little Pizza Chef Age 4Class 24Maths Top the pizza like a real chef: 5 tomatoes, 5 mushrooms, 5 olives. View Worksheet →

Class 24 is growing: 17 of the planned 30 maths worksheets are ready now — the ones whose artwork has been uploaded. The remaining adventures appear here with their own real pages the moment their artwork lands; nothing is published before it can be printed honestly.
